name: 2C-T-17
summary: 2C-T-17, also known as 4-sec-butylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or as Nimitz, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action that produces 2C-T-17's hallucinogenic effects has not been specifically established, however it is most likely to result from action as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist in the brain, a mechanism of action shared by all of the hallucinogenic tryptamines and phenethylamines for which the mechanism of action is known.
